title: Gosto
body: O aplicativo é bom e tem uma proposta interessante, mas senti falta de uma opção para reorganizar os hábitos depois que eles são adicionados. A lista fica dividida em “em cima”, “no meio” e “embaixo”, porém não é possível alterar a posição dos hábitos posteriormente. Seria muito útil permitir que o usuário pudesse editar e reorganizar a lista quando quisesse.
author: Aline era

title: Finally a Free habit tracker
body: Its simple, works and its Free. Its perfect.
author: Revan89

title: Gracias
body: Funcióna perfecto sin anuncios y gratis como nos gusta

title: Muy buena
body: Es practica, simple y perfecta para registrar las cosas que quieras dia a dia o en dias aleatorios de la semana. No es de pago por si lo creen
author: Santi.zhx

title: めちゃくちゃいい！
body:
ちょうどよくシンプルで、わかりやすいUIのアプリを探してました。色とアイコンがたくさんあるの嬉しい。
あとは登録した習慣を並べ替える機能があったら嬉しいかも？(なんとなく朝から順番に並べたい)
あとウィジェット(今日の習慣)があったら本当に嬉しくて完璧です
author: あまーすとんん

title: Review
body: Very convenient and minimalistic interface, developers are goated for not doing subscription based content
author: qxmnnn

title: Amazing experience
body: The app is an amazing way to track habits, after getting jt i actually started to do things i have delayed, however, 2 things it lacks are simultaneous tracking of all habits and a calendar that helps see back into the past
author: ꀸꀘꀸꀭꊼꀤꉓꌃꋪꀭꀭ

title: Great app just one flaw
body: Overall, a great app I’m able to check off my habits easy and track productivity. Only flaw is that there’s no way to change order after you put habits so if you want to add new ones in between you have to start over. I wish you could drag and organize that way.
author: xsteezzz
